project.label: Playable intervention-driven worlds
project.thesis: Use playable worlds to test persistent Agent participation, communication, authority, replay, and human intervention as mechanics rather than decoration.
project.question: Which forms of play become possible when people and replaceable Agents act through one persistent World history?
owns: Station Zero product and target product decisions
Game rules and authoritative World state
boundary: Station Zero v2 is the only registered current product
Station Zero v3 is an accepted unregistered replacement target, not current product truth
Long-range Game vision creates no feature commitment
No generic Host, Runtime, or universal Game-engine authority
project.problem: Most Agent games attach probabilistic dialogue to classical mechanics instead of making persistence, partial knowledge, communication, authority, and intervention part of play.
project.capability: Runs registered Station Zero v2 as a deterministic multi-Agent mission game and separately exposes an implemented Station Zero v3 first-playable target with three factions, bounded Agent planning, sealed enemy plans, explicit whole-Turn Commit, durable recovery, and a dedicated `/v3` surface.
project.maturity: Registered playable v2 product plus accepted, implemented, unregistered v3 first-playable target
project.audience: Players, game designers, and Agent researchers examining delegation, partial knowledge, adversarial roles, authoritative consequence, replay, and recoverable play.
project.latestProof: Owner authority binds `station-zero@2 / station-zero-core@3` as the current registered product while P0–P3 jointly define and verify the `station-zero@3 / station-zero-core@4` replacement target through a separate API, SQLite state, `/v3` first-playable, and process-restart recovery. Registration remains deferred pending repeated human playtesting and live-Provider evaluation.
project.summary: Intervention-driven worlds for people and Agents. Game keeps current product registration, accepted replacement targets, long-range vision, and historical releases distinct rather than treating the newest implementation as automatically shipped.
project.state: Station Zero v2 remains the registered current product. Station Zero v3 is an implemented and playable replacement target with P0–P3 accepted, but it remains outside `src/registry.ts` and the root product contract. Human playtesting and live-Provider evaluation gate any v3 registration or v2 deletion.
